arxiv-2407-15371.title: Nonequilibrium Membrane Dynamics Induced by Active Protein Interactions and Chemical Reactions: A Review
arxiv-2407-15371.creator: Hiroshi Noguchi
arxiv-2407-15371.description: Abstract Biomembranes wrapping cells and organelles are not only the partitions that separate the insides but also dynamic fields for biological functions accompanied by membrane shape changes. In this review, we discuss the spatiotemporal patterns and fluctuations of membranes under nonequilibrium conditions. In particular, we focus on theoretical analyses and simulations.

arxiv-2411-19297.title: Enhancing Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Vision Transformers through Frequency-Based Adaptation
arxiv-2411-19297.creator: Son Thai Ly, Hien V. Nguyen
arxiv-2411-19297.description: Abstract Adapting vision transformer foundation models through parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods has become increasingly popular. These methods optimize a limited subset of parameters, enabling efficient adaptation without the need to fine-tune the entire model while still achieving competitive performance. However, traditional PEFT methods may limit the model’s capacity to capture complex patterns, especially those associated with high-frequency spectra.

pmc-11577420.title: Tracking Small Extracellular Vesicles Using a Minimally Invasive PicoGreen Labeling Strategy
pmc-11577420.creator: Sagar Rayamajhi, Benjamin K Gibbs, Jared Sipes, Harsh B Pathak, Stefan H Bossmann, Andrew K Godwin
pmc-11577420.description: Extracellular vesicles (EVs) are cell-secreted lipid bilayer delimited particles that mediate cellular communication. These tiny sacs of cellular information play an important role in cell communication and alter the physiological process under both normal and pathological conditions. As such, tracking EVs can provide valuable information regarding the basic understanding of cell communication, the onset of early malignancy, and biomarker discovery.

pmc-11585591.title: Hierarchically mimicking outer tooth enamel for restorative mechanical compatibility
pmc-11585591.creator: Junfeng Lu, Jingjing Deng, Yan Wei, Xiuyi Yang, Hewei Zhao, Qihan Zhao, Shaojia Liu, Fengshi Li, Yangbei Li, Xuliang Deng, Lei Jiang, Lin Guo
pmc-11585591.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Tooth enamel, and especially the outer tooth enamel, is a load-resistant shell that benefits mastication but is easily damaged, driving the need for enamel-restorative materials with comparable properties to restore the mastication function and protect the teeth. Synthesizing an enamel analog that mimics the components and hierarchical structure of natural tooth enamel is a promising way to achieve these comparable mechanical properties, but it is still challenging to realize.

pmc-11647237.title: JC virus small tumor antigen promotes S phase entry and cell cycle progression
pmc-11647237.creator: Renato Biffi, Stefanie W. Benoit, Ilker K. Sariyer, Mahmut Safak
pmc-11647237.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The early coding region of JC virus (JCV) encodes several regulatory proteins including large T antigen (LT-Ag), small t antigen (Sm t-Ag) and T’ proteins because of the alternative splicing of the pre-mRNA. LT-Ag plays a critical role in cell transformation by targeting the key cell cycle regulatory proteins including p53 and pRb, however, the role of Sm t-Ag in this process remains elusive.

pmc-12703273.title: The WHO Medical Eligibility Criteria for Contraceptive Use 6th edition and the WHO Selected Practice Recommendations 4th edition: update and future direction

pmc-12703273.description: riteria for Contraceptive Use (MEC) present WHO recommendations on the safety of various contraceptive methods in the context of specific health conditions and physical characteristics. pmc-13280722.title: A multi-modal foundation model for brain disease diagnosis and medical imaging
pmc-13280722.creator: Guoxun Zhang, Zebin Gao, Caohui Duan, Jiaxin Liu, Yuerong Lizhu, Yaou Liu, Qian Chen, Ling Wang, Kailun Fei, Tianyun Wang, YuJia Chen, Yanchen Guo, Feng Xu, Yuchen Guo, Xin Lou, Qionghai Dai
pmc-13280722.description: SummaryThe precise and comprehensive diagnosis of complex brain disorders relies on non-invasive computed tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) in conjunction with multi-modal clinical information. Here, we present Brainfound, a multi-modal foundation model for brain medical imaging that integrates image-text contrastive learning with a diffusion-based generative framework.

pmc-13321449.title: Proof-of-concept engineering of Escherichia coli expressing a bee-derived cytochrome P450 monooxygenase for thiamethoxam detoxification
pmc-13321449.creator: Pachara Sattayawat, Kasimaporn Promubon, Kritapas Sripinta, Warisa Chunguaongsuk, Chonlaphon Juntama, Nuttapol Noirungsee, Aussara Panya, Terd Disayathanoowat
pmc-13321449.description: Bees are unintentionally exposed to pesticides applied to control other insect pests. Although bees possess endogenous detoxification mechanisms, their efficiency may not always be sufficient. To this end, the use of probiotics that can assist in pesticide detoxification may offer an additional layer of protection.

pmc-13495308.title: Evaluation of fetal brain development in growth restriction subtypes using brain MRI volume measurement
pmc-13495308.creator: Chuan Fei Xie, Chun Yan Zhong, Wei Tang, Song Peng
pmc-13495308.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundThis retrospective study aims to explore the value of brain MRI volume measurements in evaluating fetal brain development in fetal growth restriction (FGR) fetuses, by comparing 2 subtypes of FGR with appropriate gestational age (AGA) fetuses.MethodsA total of 169 fetal brain MRI with suspected abnormal development, identified through ultrasound screening at this hospital between 2021 and 2025 were analyzed,11 cases were excluded.

pmc-13655434.title: The effects of blood flow restriction training during low intensity online resistance training with older adults
pmc-13655434.creator: Daniela Presta, Emma H. Chen, Kate Kraemer, Andreas Bergdahl
pmc-13655434.description: [Purpose] Blood flow restriction (BFR) training involves limiting blood flow to specific areas, enabling low-intensity exercise to mimic high-intensity workouts. This study explored the effectiveness of combining BFR with online exercise classes to improve strength and functionality in older adults.

pmc-13690455.title: Identifying risk factors for procedural pain in outpatient hysteroscopy: A multivariable analysis
pmc-13690455.creator: Shin-Yi Chen, Wei-Li Lin, Jie Chin Lim, Chen-Ti Wang, Cindy Hsuan Weng, Angel Chao, Yu-Ying Su, Yi-Ting Huang, Kai-Yun Wu, Chin-Jung Wang
pmc-13690455.description: Background:To identify patient-related clinical and anatomical factors associated with increased pain during office hysteroscopy.Methods:This retrospective study included women who underwent office hysteroscopy without anesthesia at a tertiary referral center between August and November 2024. Pain intensity was assessed immediately after the procedure using a 10-cm visual analog scale (VAS).
